Name: Love and Deepspace Zayne's Mod - English Translation
Author: MiscMemos
Description:
[b][size=5]Zayne English Localization Redo — 4.2.3[/size][/b]
[b](This is a fresh release replacing Nexus ID 51136. The previous page accumulated too many small edits, so I’ve consolidated the work here into a cleaner, fully reviewed version.) [/b]

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[b]This is a standalone English version of the complete Zayne 4.2.0 content pack. It is not a translation add-on.[/b]

Remove any other copy of the Zayne content pack before installing, including the original Chinese release. Both packages use the same internal mod ID, so SMAPI cannot load them together.

[list=1]
[*]Install the required dependencies:
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.3.2+[/b][/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher 2.8.0+[/b][/*]
[*][b]SpaceCore 1.28.4+[/b][/*]
[*][b]CentralStation 1.7.0+[/b][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Extract the download.[/*]
[*]Place the [b]Zayne_EN[/b] folder in your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]About This Release[/heading]
[list]
[*]This is a standalone English localization and compatibility release based on version 4.2.0 of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40300][b]Love and Deepspace Zayne's Mod[/b][/url] by [b]MoLiNaiLvMianMianBing[/b].[/*]
[*]All original artwork, maps, music, items, recipes, gameplay systems, character implementation, and other original mod content belong to the original creator.[/*]
[*]This package localizes the Chinese 4.2.0 release into English and also includes a number of structural updates and limited fixes needed to keep the localized content organized and functioning correctly under current Stardew Valley 1.6 / Content Patcher conventions.[/*]
[*][b]It does not add new maps, items, recipes, romance progression, combat effects, or other original gameplay systems.[/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]English Localization[/heading]
All player-facing Chinese text in the 4.2.0 release has been localized into English.

[spoiler]This includes regular and marriage dialogue, event text, festival and schedule dialogue, movie content, mail, shops, items, recipes, machines, buffs, furniture, map text, and other player-facing strings.

The English text was localized for natural phrasing, pacing, and characterization rather than treated as a strictly literal line-by-line translation.

Additional Zayne-specific dialogue was also added for situations which otherwise fall back to generic vanilla responses, including:
[list]
[*]dating, proposal, and rejection responses;[/*]
[*]birthdays and gift responses;[/*]
[*]pregnancy, adoption, and family states;[/*]
[*]spouse routines and household actions;[/*]
[*]decorating responses;[/*]
[*]seasonal and Green Rain dialogue;[/*]
[*]resort dialogue;[/*]
[*]movie invitations and rejection responses;[/*]
[*]mine-rescue dialogue;[/*]
[*]summit dialogue.[/*]
[/list]The gender-dependent introductory mail was localized and reformatted for clearer English presentation.

The opening [b]CG0[/b] notice was replaced with an English version retaining the original creator's noncommercial notice, warning regarding unauthorized paid copies, creator attribution, and support-group information.

An English and edited version of the [b]Important Notes and Guide[/b] is also included.

Developer-facing comments, labels, section headings, and log names were translated where useful for maintaining the English package.

Official [i]Love and Deepspace[/i] English terminology is used where applicable.

[line]
[/spoiler]
[line]
[heading]Localization Integration & String Consolidation[/heading]
The original 4.2.0 package distributes related dialogue and localization across several files and includes a number of duplicate, hard-coded, or globally scoped strings. The English release consolidates those strings so localized text is easier to maintain and is applied only where intended.

[spoiler][list]
[*]Replaced the original Chinese localization setup with one complete English [b]i18n/default.json[/b].[/*]
[*]Consolidated actively referenced localization keys while preserving compatibility aliases still used by Zayne-specific dialogue systems.[/*]
[*]Integrated loose schedule dialogue into the appropriate animation and spouse-dialogue handling rather than maintaining separate hard-coded schedule strings.[/*]
[*]Incorporated the seven weekday married-morning strings as weekday-specific overrides of the relevant spouse morning dialogue entries.[/*]
[*]Expanded the original summit handling to include the complete set of relevant Zayne spouse summit strings.[/*]
[*]Moved the hard-coded Chinese greeting for the [b]TJP[/b] shop into i18n as [b]Zayne.TJP.Dialogue[/b].[/*]
[*]Reworked movie-invitation rejection handling so Zayne-specific responses use NPC-specific dialogue hooks rather than replacing shared vanilla movie strings globally.[/*]
[*]Removed the redundant alternate movie-invitation override set and retained one consistent Zayne-specific English implementation.[/*]
[*]Corrected the source typo [b]ZayneIntordactionMail[/b] to [b]ZayneIntroductionMail[/b] consistently across the event trigger, mail data, and i18n key.[/*]
[*]Removed duplicate New Year's Eve mail registration so the same mail is not being registered through multiple source paths.[/*]
[/list][b][u]Movie Reaction Ordering[/u][/b]
The original 4.2.0 movie-reaction list places Zayne's wildcard ***** reaction before the eight movie-specific reactions.
Because the wildcard can match any movie, it can be selected before the game reaches the authored spring, summer, fall, winter, and Year 2 reactions.

The English package moves the wildcard reaction to the [b]end[/b] of the list. The eight movie-specific reactions are therefore checked first, while the wildcard remains available as the intended fallback for any movie without a dedicated reaction.
This does not change the authored reactions themselves; it changes only their ordering so the specific entries can be reached reliably.

[line]
[/spoiler]
[line]
[heading]Stardew Valley 1.6 / Content Patcher Compatibility[/heading]
The original 4.2.0 content pack contains a mixture of older Content Patcher structures and newer Stardew Valley 1.6 data. The English release updates those structures while preserving the mod's established internal IDs wherever possible.

[spoiler][b][u][size=4]Location and Character Data[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Updated the Content Patcher format from [b]2.3.0[/b] to [b]2.8.0[/b].[/*]
[*]Replaced the deprecated root-level [b]CustomLocations[/b] system with native Stardew Valley 1.6 [b]Data/Locations[/b] registration.[/*]
[*]Preserved established location IDs such as [b]Custom_ZayneHome[/b], [b]Custom_ZayneMap[/b], [b]Custom_XueRong[/b], and the other existing [b]Custom_*[/b] names so schedules, warps, events, and existing references continue using the same IDs.[/*]
[*]Consolidated location registration where separate patches could otherwise overwrite fishing or other location properties.[/*]
[*]Removed unsupported legacy character fields which are no longer part of the current Stardew Valley character-data model.[/*]
[*]Removed [b]FestivalVanillaActorIndex[/b]. Zayne is already placed explicitly through festival additional-character data, making the legacy actor-index assignment unnecessary and potentially conflicting.[/*]
[*]Removed the redundant [b]Custom_ZayneShopIn4[/b] location/map path and routed its only event use through the existing [b]Custom_ZayneShopIn[/b] location.[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]Festival Data[/size][/u][/b]
The vanilla festival section was reorganized so each festival's dialogue and placement data are maintained together instead of separating the normal-year and alternate-year patches into two distant groups.
[list]
[*]Changed festival placement handling to explicit [b]_y1[/b] and [b]_y2[/b] variants while preserving the original authored coordinates.[/*]
[*]Preserved the original alternate-year placement differences for festivals which use a different Year 2 layout.[/*]
[*]The Flower Dance does not support the normal NPC [b]_spouse[/b] festival-dialogue variant. The original second Zayne Flower Dance line therefore could not function as spouse-specific dialogue. That line is now assigned to [b]Zayne_y2[/b] / [b]Festivals.spring24_y2[/b] instead, allowing it to function as alternate-year Flower Dance dialogue.[/*]
[*]Corrected the Festival of Ice to use its special hyphenated [b]Main-Event_additionalCharacters[/b] field name.[/*]
[*]Removed Spirit's Eve main-event placement entries because that festival does not define a separate [b]mainEvent[/b] sequence.[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]Machine and Item Data[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Removed obsolete [b]CanPurchase[/b] and [b]PurchasePrice[/b] fields from the Stone Mill, Tea Drying Rack, and Bamboo Steamer definitions. Purchase prices remain controlled by their shop entries.[/*]
[*]Qualified the Stone Mill, Drying Rack, and Bamboo Steamer shop entries as big-craftable item IDs.[/*]
[*]Made Matcha Powder explicitly giftable for gift exchange with Zayne.[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]TJP Shop[/size][/u][/b]
The original 4.2.0 [b]TJP[/b] shop includes a nonfunctional tool-upgrade option.

Because the intended upgrade cannot be implemented through Content Patcher alone and would require custom DLL code, the English release removes that entry while leaving the rest of the shop unchanged. 

[b][u][size=4]Source and Asset Cleanup[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Removed superseded or unreferenced source files from the English package where they were no longer used by the current implementation.[/*]
[*]Removed a redundant XueRong fishing patch which was later overwritten by the complete location definition.[/*]
[*]Corrected asset-path capitalization and file references where needed for better compatibility with case-sensitive filesystems.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
These changes are structural updates to existing content rather than new gameplay design.
[line]
[heading]Functional Bug Fixes[/heading]
Only a small number of source behaviors were deliberately changed because the original implementation did not perform its apparent intended function.
[spoiler]
[b][u]Zayne Dessert Shop[/u][/b]
The original 4.2.0 [b]ZayneShop[/b] owner definition placed the custom merchant portrait reference inside the individual dialogue entry instead of on the shop-owner definition.

The English release:
[list]
[*]moves the portrait reference to the proper owner-level field;[/*]
[*]explicitly loads the dedicated [b]assets/Image/ZaynePortraits.png[/b] shop portrait asset;[/*]
[*]preserves the original [b]ZayneShop[/b] shop ID, owner identity, dialogue identity, and shop inventory;[/*]
[*]keeps the shop dialogue in i18n.[/*]
[/list]This allows the intended shop portrait and merchant presentation to function correctly without changing the shop's content.

[b][u]Bamboo Tea Heater[/u][/b]
The new 4.2.0 matcha-processing chain appears intended to require both tea leaves and Coal, but the original Bamboo Tea Heater rule treats Tea Leaves and Coal as separate alternative machine triggers.

That allows Coal to behave as though it were the recipe input and allows tea processing without consuming Coal as fuel.

The English release changes the machine logic to:
[list]
[*][b]1 Tea Leaves + 1 Coal → 1 Fixed Tea Leaves[/b][/*]
[*][b]1 Air-Dried Tea Leaves + 1 Coal → 1 Heat-Dried Tea Leaves[/b][/*]
[/list]Coal is now handled as an additional consumed fuel item rather than as an alternative machine input.

The Bamboo Tea Heater's error handling was also separated so the game can distinguish between:
[list]
[*]an invalid tea input; and[/*]
[*]missing Coal.[/*]
[/list][line]
[/spoiler]
[line]
